Package org.saidone.protoalf.client

Class ContentServiceClient

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.protoalf.client.ContentServiceClient
public class ContentServiceClient extends Object
Client of the platform's content service: byte slices, writes, downloads and streaming document creation.

Each call sends the shared provider's Alfresco ticket and a per-call deadline. Unary calls retry once after UNAUTHENTICATED if the provider supplies a different ticket. The caller owns the channel and should share one TicketProvider across service clients.

Downloads retry only before any payload bytes have been written. Uploads are never replayed because the supplied input stream may not be rewindable.

    • ContentServiceClient

      public ContentServiceClient(io.grpc.Channel channel, TicketProvider tickets, Duration deadline)
      Creates this service client with shared authentication and a per-call deadline.

      The caller retains ownership of the channel; closing an application should close its shared channel once.

      Parameters:
      channel - shared gRPC channel; ownership remains with the caller
      tickets - shared ticket provider, normally one AuthenticationServiceClient
      deadline - per-call deadline applied to every RPC attempt

    • downloadContent

      public org.saidone.protoalf.api.ContentInfo downloadContent(String nodeRef, OutputStream out)
      Streams the stored bytes of a document into out, which is not closed. The deadline covers the whole download. On UNAUTHENTICATED the ticket is renewed and the download retried once, but only while nothing has been written to out yet; otherwise the StatusRuntimeException is rethrown.
      Parameters:
      nodeRef - node reference, bare workspace ID or supported repository alias
      out - destination stream, which remains open and owned by the caller
      Returns:
      the stored content metadata; missing content has zero size

    • uploadContent

      public org.saidone.protoalf.api.Node uploadContent(org.saidone.protoalf.api.CreateDocumentHeader header, InputStream data)
      Creates a document: the header first, then the bytes of data in chunks of at most 1 MB. Returns the created node. The stream is read but not closed.

      The deadline covers the whole upload, so it must be generous for large files. An UNAUTHENTICATED answer drops the ticket (the next call logs in again) and rethrows the StatusRuntimeException: this method is never retried, because the input stream cannot be rewound. Open the stream again and call it again.

      Parameters:
      header - parent, name, type, properties, aspects and content metadata of the new document
      data - source stream; it is read once and remains owned by the caller
      Returns:
      the resulting node snapshot
